purpose: Describe doing something without performing another action.
keywords: Verb negative stem + ずに; する → せずに
I went out without eating breakfast.
I tried reading without using a dictionary.
formation: Verb negative stem + ずに; する → せずに
restrictions: Often a more written alternative to ないで; subjects usually match.
mistake: The irregular form is せずに, not しずに.
